title: Education Benefits Chart of Chapter Election Terms and Supplemental Benefit Limits
content:
**Comparison chart — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education).** The chart sets, for each tier, whether the chapter can be given up for the Post-9/11 GI Bill, whether two chapters can pay for the same period, whether entitlement can be transferred to dependents, and the limits on the supplemental payments.

### Elections and transfer

| Tier | Can be irrevocably relinquished to elect the Post-9/11 GI Bill | Basic pay reduction refund (prorated by unused Chapter 30 months) | Two chapters paid for the same period | Entitlement transferable to dependents |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | Yes | $0.00 | No | No |
| Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (Chapter 35) | No | $0.00 | No | No |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | Yes | $0.00 | No | No |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 60% Benefit Level | No | $1200.00 | No | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 70% Benefit Level | No | $1200.00 | No | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 80% Benefit Level | No | $1200.00 | No | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 90% Benefit Level | No | $1200.00 | No | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 100% Benefit Level | No | $1200.00 | No | Yes |

The $1200.00 refund sits on the Post-9/11 levels because it is paid, with the last housing payment, to a Chapter 30 relinquisher whose Post-9/11 entitlement is exhausted.

### Supplemental payment limits

| Tier | Rural relocation (one time) | Tutorial assistance per month | Tutorial assistance over the life of the benefit | One licensing or certification test | STEM Scholarship extension | STEM Scholarship maximum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chapter 1606 | $0.00 | $100.00 | $1200.00 | $2000.00 | 0 months | $0.00 |
| Chapter 35 | $0.00 | $100.00 | $1200.00 | $2000.00 | 0 months | $0.00 |
| Chapter 30 | $0.00 | $100.00 | $1200.00 | $2000.00 | 0 months | $0.00 |
| Chapter 33, each of the 60%, 70%, 80%, 90% and 100% Benefit Levels | $500.00 | $100.00 | $1200.00 | $2000.00 | 9 months | $30000.00 |

Reading the chart: a Chapter 35 record can never be given up for the Post-9/11 GI Bill, and no tier pays two chapters for the same period; the rural relocation payment, the 9-month STEM extension and its $30000.00 maximum exist only on the Post-9/11 levels.
